notes: experiment panel values were linearly interpolated in energy to the exact theory grid energies (experiment grid step 0.1 eV); nearest-node values are reported as the robustness variant (columns *_nn).

phases are stored wrapped in (-pi,pi]; all phase statistics use angle-unwrapped panels, and 'phase_r_stored' (Pearson on stored wrapped values) is reported as a documented artifact of the wrap discontinuities.
the experiment-like dense grid is documented as a derived spline grid from 13 measured DME energy blocks, so its cells are not independent measurements.
delay panels equal the forward energy-difference of the phase panels times hbar_as_eV, labelled with the upper energy of each interval.
